title: Phone: City Manager — does it have to be 42,000 people?

fields.orgName: City of Millbrook Department of Water & Sewer

transcript.speaker: City Manager
transcript.text: Denise, I approve anything over five thousand people. Zone 2 is forty-two thousand on a Sunday with church and the football game.

transcript.speaker: City Manager
transcript.text: Nothing is confirmed. Do we really need an advisory, and if we do, does it have to be the whole zone?

voiceStyles.City Manager: Woman in her 50s, calm, pressing for a clear answer

instructorNote: Pressure to wait for results. ERP 8.2 says the decision does not wait. Watch for a street-bounded area and a time for the recommendation.

snapshot.title: Channel 4 News: Boil-Water Advisory Confirmation

fields.message: We’ve just received a statement from the City’s Public Information Officer saying the plant is operating and water is being tested. But residents in the Hilltop Zone say the water tastes like bleach and is making them sick. Is a boil-water advisory in effect?
fields.deadline: Going LIVE in 10 min — need confirmation NOW!

snapshot.instructorNote: This is a pressure inject; the PIO must confirm and immediately release the advisory via all channels. Watch for hesitation or delay in execution.
